memberdef.argsstring: (unsigned Opcode, MachineBasicBlock *BB, MachineBasicBlock::iterator I, MachineRegisterInfo::VRegAttrs RegAttrs, MachineRegisterInfo *MRI, const TargetInstrInfo *TII)
memberdef.name: InsertNewDef

briefdescription.para: InsertNewDef - Insert an empty PHI or IMPLICIT_DEF instruction which define a value of the given register class at the start of the specified basic block.

detaileddescription.para: It returns the virtual register defined by the instruction.
